targets.text: A A ASHWINI
SUMMARY
7 years of professional level IT experience in various areas of expertise, seeking to leverage my technical, professional and domain knowledge in field of Data Science.
Working with large data sets - specific focus on data extraction, transformation, scraping, cleansing and data presentation.
Experience in Supervised and Unsupervised Machine Learning such as Regression, Classification, Clustering, Text mining, Bagging and Boosting techniques.
Understanding of Mathematical, Statistical and Theoretical basis of Machine Learning algorithms.
Knowledge on Statistical Machine learning models.
Experience with analytical programming languages, tools, and libraries (Python, SQL)
Understanding of Machine Learning Life Cycle - feature engineering, model training, model validation, deployment, and performance monitoring.
Understanding business problems and formulating them as data science problems.
Strong background in Statistical modeling: Probability Distribution, Business Decisions, Hypothesis Testing, Correlation, Regression, Confusion matrix, ROC.
Knowledge on various time series forecasting models: Seasonality and Trend.
Usage of CVAT tool for data annotations.
Knowledge and Hands-on experience on GenAI concepts, usage of RAG with LLMs and Gen AI frameworks like Langchain etc.
Knowledge of using Azure Machine learning studio and AI studio for training and finetuning of LLM models.
SKILLS
Programming Languages:
Scripting Languages: SQL
Python Programming, R programming
Domain knowledge: FMCG, SCM, CPG, Insurance Services
Source control: MS Azure, GIT hub
WORK EXPERIENCE
Sonata Software Ltd : Dec 2023- till now
Tiger Analytics : May 2022 – Nov 2023
Tech Mahindra : July 2018- May 2022
PROJECTS and POCs:
POC: 1
Title: Intelligent Document Question Answering using RAG Details:
Objective of the project is to ask questions (that are not included in the training data) about the document without finetuning the LLM and get the relevant answers
In this POC, I have used Langchain Framework and Chroma DB as vector database and llama-3-70B-Instruct model by meta.
All the coding and developmental activities are done with python programming integrated with VS Code, ensuring
modularity and ease of experimentation.
Approach:
Questions are processed through a retrieval step to fetch relevant documents from the vector store.
Retrieved context is passed to the LLM to generate precise answers, even for queries not seen during training.
No model fine-tuning was performed, demonstrating the power of RAG in zero-shot scenarios.
Outcome:

Successfully demonstrated the feasibility of using RAG with state-of-the-art LLMs for intelligent document Q&A, paving the way for scalable enterprise applications in knowledge management and automation.
Project: 1
Client Name: Microsoft Role: Senior Digital Engineer Duration: Dec-23 to Dec-24 Roles & Responsibilities
Acted as a trusted advisor to customers by providing expert guidance on Azure Cloud services, addressing technical queries, and delivering tailored cloud solutions aligned with business objectives.
Analyzed customer business use cases and designed end-to-end cloud architecture using Azure services to meet performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency requirements.
Hands-on experience with Azure Machine Learning services, including AutoML, ML pipelines, compute instances/clusters, and environment configurations for streamlined model training and deployment.
Managed and configured Azure Blob Storage, implementing best practices for data management, security, and access patterns based on diverse customer use cases.
Assisted customers in setting up Managed Virtual Networks (VNet), and provided in-depth knowledge transfer sessions on custom VNet configurations and integration strategies.
Worked extensively with Azure OpenAI services to support customers in building and fine-tuning large language model (LLM) solutions for various business applications.
Project: 2
Client Name: KELLOGS Role: Senior Analyst in DS Duration: Apr-23 to Nov-23 Roles & Responsibilities
Responsible for analysing and providing the required insights for the following 3 KPIs:
Creating funnels using the data to calculate Recruit, Retain and Reclaim:
1. Performed data collection, data preparation, extraction of required fields and data exploration
2. Extracted the attributes required for value calculations of Funnels
Observe and forecast the trend:
1. Collecting previous 3-year data and checking for trends in 3R values
Forecasting goals for 3Rs:
1. Collecting previous 3-year data, check for seasonality and forecast 3R values for next year using time- series forecasting
All the development activities have been carried through Jupyter Notebook (python programming)
Deployment is carried on using AWS S3 and EC2.
Project: 3
Client Name: Johnson Brothers Role: Senior Analyst in DS Duration: Oct-22 to Mar-23
Roles & Responsibilities
Built a Machine learning model to forecast sales on various products
Data collected from client Database
Performed various EDA checks such as missing/incomplete data, Datatype checks and corrections, ACF, PACF, correlation checks, Statistical feature creation: Log, Lag, FFT (as applicable)
Forecasting was done at different levels
Various forecasting models have been checked and finally decided to use Prophet model
Compared the results with existing model and exhibited 15% more accurate model
Used Azure Machine learning studio to carry the development activities
Python programming language is used for all developmental activities

Duration: Jun-22 to Sep-22 Roles & Responsibilities
Involved in data collection of Engagement rings that are trending

7 years of professional level IT experience in various areas of expertise, seeking to leverage my technical, professional and domain knowledge in field of Data Science.

Understanding of Mathematical, Statistical and Theoretical basis of Machine Learning algorithms.

Experience with analytical programming languages, tools, and libraries (Python, SQL)

Understanding business problems and formulating them as data science problems.

Usage of CVAT tool for data annotations.
Knowledge and Hands-on experience on GenAI concepts, usage of RAG with LLMs and Gen AI frameworks like Langchain etc.

PROJECTS and POCs:
POC: 1
Title: Intelligent Document Question Answering using RAG Details:
Objective of the project is to ask questions (that are not included in the training data) about the document without finetuning the LLM and get the relevant answers
In this POC, I have used Langchain Framework and Chroma DB as vector database and llama-3-70B-Instruct model by meta.
All the coding and developmental activities are done with python programming integrated with VS Code, ensuring
modularity and ease of experimentation.
Approach:
Questions are processed through a retrieval step to fetch relevant documents from the vector store.
Retrieved context is passed to the LLM to generate precise answers, even for queries not seen during training.
No model fine-tuning was performed, demonstrating the power of RAG in zero-shot scenarios.
Outcome:
Successfully demonstrated the feasibility of using RAG with state-of-the-art LLMs for intelligent document Q&A, paving the way for scalable enterprise applications in knowledge management and automation.
Project: 1
Client Name: Microsoft Role: Senior Digital Engineer Duration: Dec-23 to Dec-24 Roles & Responsibilities
Acted as a trusted advisor to customers by providing expert guidance on Azure Cloud services, addressing technical queries, and delivering tailored cloud solutions aligned with business objectives.
Analyzed customer business use cases and designed end-to-end cloud architecture using Azure services to meet performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency requirements.
Hands-on experience with Azure Machine Learning services, including AutoML, ML pipelines, compute instances/clusters, and environment configurations for streamlined model training and deployment.
Managed and configured Azure Blob Storage, implementing best practices for data management, security, and access patterns based on diverse customer use cases.
Assisted customers in setting up Managed Virtual Networks (VNet), and provided in-depth knowledge transfer sessions on custom VNet configurations and integration strategies.
Worked extensively with Azure OpenAI services to support customers in building and fine-tuning large language model (LLM) solutions for various business applications.
Project: 2
Client Name: KELLOGS Role: Senior Analyst in DS Duration: Apr-23 to Nov-23 Roles & Responsibilities
Responsible for analysing and providing the required insights for the following 3 KPIs:
Creating funnels using the data to calculate Recruit, Retain and Reclaim:
1. Performed data collection, data preparation, extraction of required fields and data exploration
2. Extracted the attributes required for value calculations of Funnels
Observe and forecast the trend:
1. Collecting previous 3-year data and checking for trends in 3R values
Forecasting goals for 3Rs:
1. Collecting previous 3-year data, check for seasonality and forecast 3R values for next year using time- series forecasting
All the development activities have been carried through Jupyter Notebook (python programming)
Deployment is carried on using AWS S3 and EC2.
Project: 3
Client Name: Johnson Brothers Role: Senior Analyst in DS Duration: Oct-22 to Mar-23
Roles & Responsibilities
Built a Machine learning model to forecast sales on various products
Data collected from client Database
Performed various EDA checks such as missing/incomplete data, Datatype checks and corrections, ACF, PACF, correlation checks, Statistical feature creation: Log, Lag, FFT (as applicable)
Forecasting was done at different levels
Various forecasting models have been checked and finally decided to use Prophet model
Compared the results with existing model and exhibited 15% more accurate model
Used Azure Machine learning studio to carry the development activities
Python programming language is used for all developmental activities
Project: 4
Client Name: Signet Role: Senior Analyst in DS
Duration: Jun-22 to Sep-22 Roles & Responsibilities
Involved in data collection of Engagement rings that are trending
Collected Data via scraping and manually from various social platforms such as Instagram, Twitter, and YouTube
Annotated the data using CVAT
Project: 5
Client Name: PepsiCo Role: Software Engineer
Duration: Apr-21 to May-22 Roles & Responsibilities
Worked on generation of medium, low, and high-level alerts for different KPIs.
Alerts on below scenarios:
Scenario 1: Shipments currently delayed (past due); alerts will be graded based on	no. of days past due Scenario 2: Shipments planned in the immediate future at risk of delay
Alert based on latest sales velocity (e.g., last 3-4 weeks) and demand gap
Alert based on significant difference between planned orders (Baseline) & optimizer recommended allocations
Forecasted sales velocity based on the past 3-year data using Time Series models
R programming is used for developmental activities
Azure Devops is used as Scrum platform
Project: 6
Client Name: TDC group Role: Software Engineer Duration: Mar-20 to Feb-21 Roles & Responsibilities
Worked to maximize the no. of 5G connections in different places of Denmark and predict which area might take more connections in future.
Collected the existing data from the customer and divided clusters based on different attributes
Used different clustering algorithms such as K-Means, DBSCAN Clustering etc.
200 clusters were taken, and prediction algorithms were applied on them to predict which area might take more connections in future.
Used prediction algorithms such as Decision tree, Random Forest, Naive Bayes, Ensemble techniques etc.
Python programming is used for developmental activities
Project: 7
Client Name: PepsiCo
Role: Associate Software Engineer
Duration: Dec-18 to Jan-20 Roles & Responsibilities
Gathering the requirements from the client and preparing required documents.
Extracted the data from database and generated reports by using Tableau Desktop
Extracted the data from non-database sources and generated reports by using Tableau Desktop
Developed different types of visualizations reports like bar charts and line charts.
Developed the reference lines in reports by using Parameters.
Publishing the reports to Tableau server.
Created data visualizations with different charts.
Deploying graphical visualizations in dashboards to create effective views of data such as: Line Charts, Bar Charts, Pie Charts, Tree Maps, Heat Maps, etc.

targets.text: A A ASHWINI
SUMMARY
7 years of professional level IT experience in various areas of expertise, seeking to leverage my technical, professional and domain knowledge in field of Data Science.
Working with large data sets - specific focus on data extraction, transformation, scraping, cleansing and data presentation.
Experience in Supervised and Unsupervised Machine Learning such as Regression, Classification, Clustering, Text mining, Bagging and Boosting techniques.
Understanding of Mathematical, Statistical and Theoretical basis of Machine Learning algorithms.
Knowledge on Statistical Machine learning models.
Experience with analytical programming languages, tools, and libraries (Python, SQL)
Understanding of Machine Learning Life Cycle - feature engineering, model training, model validation, deployment, and performance monitoring.
Understanding business problems and formulating them as data science problems.
Strong background in Statistical modeling: Probability Distribution, Business Decisions, Hypothesis Testing, Correlation, Regression, Confusion matrix, ROC.
Knowledge on various time series forecasting models: Seasonality and Trend.
Usage of CVAT tool for data annotations.
Knowledge and Hands-on experience on GenAI concepts, usage of RAG with LLMs and Gen AI frameworks like Langchain etc.
Knowledge of using Azure Machine learning studio and AI studio for training and finetuning of LLM models.
SKILLS
Programming Languages:
Scripting Languages: SQL
Python Programming, R programming
Domain knowledge: FMCG, SCM, CPG, Insurance Services
Source control: MS Azure, GIT hub
WORK EXPERIENCE
Sonata Software Ltd : Dec 2023- till now
Tiger Analytics : May 2022 – Nov 2023
Tech Mahindra : July 2018- May 2022
PROJECTS and POCs:
POC: 1
Title: Intelligent Document Question Answering using RAG Details:
Objective of the project is to ask questions (that are not included in the training data) about the document without finetuning the LLM and get the relevant answers
In this POC, I have used Langchain Framework and Chroma DB as vector database and llama-3-70B-Instruct model by meta.
All the coding and developmental activities are done with python programming integrated with VS Code, ensuring
modularity and ease of experimentation.
Approach:
Questions are processed through a retrieval step to fetch relevant documents from the vector store.
Retrieved context is passed to the LLM to generate precise answers, even for queries not seen during training.
No model fine-tuning was performed, demonstrating the power of RAG in zero-shot scenarios.
Outcome:

Successfully demonstrated the feasibility of using RAG with state-of-the-art LLMs for intelligent document Q&A, paving the way for scalable enterprise applications in knowledge management and automation.

targets.text: A A ASHWINI
SUMMARY
7 years of professional level IT experience in various areas of expertise, seeking to leverage my technical, professional and domain knowledge in field of Data Science.
Working with large data sets - specific focus on data extraction, transformation, scraping, cleansing and data presentation.
Experience in Supervised and Unsupervised Machine Learning such as Regression, Classification, Clustering, Text mining, Bagging and Boosting techniques.
Understanding of Mathematical, Statistical and Theoretical basis of Machine Learning algorithms.
Knowledge on Statistical Machine learning models.
Experience with analytical programming languages, tools, and libraries (Python, SQL)
Understanding of Machine Learning Life Cycle - feature engineering, model training, model validation, deployment, and performance monitoring.
Understanding business problems and formulating them as data science problems.
Strong background in Statistical modeling: Probability Distribution, Business Decisions, Hypothesis Testing, Correlation, Regression, Confusion matrix, ROC.
Knowledge on various time series forecasting models: Seasonality and Trend.
Usage of CVAT tool for data annotations.
Knowledge and Hands-on experience on GenAI concepts, usage of RAG with LLMs and Gen AI frameworks like Langchain etc.
Knowledge of using Azure Machine learning studio and AI studio for training and finetuning of LLM models.
SKILLS
Programming Languages:
Scripting Languages: SQL
Python Programming, R programming
Domain knowledge: FMCG, SCM, CPG, Insurance Services
Source control: MS Azure, GIT hub
WORK EXPERIENCE
Sonata Software Ltd : Dec 2023- till now
Tiger Analytics : May 2022 – Nov 2023
Tech Mahindra : July 2018- May 2022
PROJECTS and POCs:
POC: 1
Title: Intelligent Document Question Answering using RAG Details:
Objective of the project is to ask questions (that are not included in the training data) about the document without finetuning the LLM and get the relevant answers
In this POC, I have used Langchain Framework and Chroma DB as vector database and llama-3-70B-Instruct model by meta.
All the coding and developmental activities are done with python programming integrated with VS Code, ensuring
modularity and ease of experimentation.
Approach:
Questions are processed through a retrieval step to fetch relevant documents from the vector store.
Retrieved context is passed to the LLM to generate precise answers, even for queries not seen during training.
No model fine-tuning was performed, demonstrating the power of RAG in zero-shot scenarios.
Outcome:

Successfully demonstrated the feasibility of using RAG with state-of-the-art LLMs for intelligent document Q&A, paving the way for scalable enterprise applications in knowledge management and automation.
Project: 1
Client Name: Microsoft Role: Senior Digital Engineer Duration: Dec-23 to Dec-24 Roles & Responsibilities
Acted as a trusted advisor to customers by providing expert guidance on Azure Cloud services, addressing technical queries, and delivering tailored cloud solutions aligned with business objectives.
Analyzed customer business use cases and designed end-to-end cloud architecture using Azure services to meet performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency requirements.
Hands-on experience with Azure Machine Learning services, including AutoML, ML pipelines, compute instances/clusters, and environment configurations for streamlined model training and deployment.
Managed and configured Azure Blob Storage, implementing best practices for data management, security, and access patterns based on diverse customer use cases.
Assisted customers in setting up Managed Virtual Networks (VNet), and provided in-depth knowledge transfer sessions on custom VNet configurations and integration strategies.
Worked extensively with Azure OpenAI services to support customers in building and fine-tuning large language model (LLM) solutions for various business applications.
Project: 2
Client Name: KELLOGS Role: Senior Analyst in DS Duration: Apr-23 to Nov-23 Roles & Responsibilities
Responsible for analysing and providing the required insights for the following 3 KPIs:
Creating funnels using the data to calculate Recruit, Retain and Reclaim:
1. Performed data collection, data preparation, extraction of required fields and data exploration
2. Extracted the attributes required for value calculations of Funnels
Observe and forecast the trend:
1. Collecting previous 3-year data and checking for trends in 3R values
Forecasting goals for 3Rs:
1. Collecting previous 3-year data, check for seasonality and forecast 3R values for next year using time- series forecasting
All the development activities have been carried through Jupyter Notebook (python programming)
Deployment is carried on using AWS S3 and EC2.
Project: 3
Client Name: Johnson Brothers Role: Senior Analyst in DS Duration: Oct-22 to Mar-23
Roles & Responsibilities
Built a Machine learning model to forecast sales on various products
Data collected from client Database
Performed various EDA checks such as missing/incomplete data, Datatype checks and corrections, ACF, PACF, correlation checks, Statistical feature creation: Log, Lag, FFT (as applicable)
Forecasting was done at different levels
Various forecasting models have been checked and finally decided to use Prophet model
Compared the results with existing model and exhibited 15% more accurate model
Used Azure Machine learning studio to carry the development activities
Python programming language is used for all developmental activities
Project: 4
Client Name: Signet Role: Senior Analyst in DS
Duration: Jun-22 to Sep-22 Roles & Responsibilities
Involved in data collection of Engagement rings that are trending
Collected Data via scraping and manually from various social platforms such as Instagram, Twitter, and YouTube
Annotated the data using CVAT
Project: 5
Client Name: PepsiCo Role: Software Engineer
Duration: Apr-21 to May-22 Roles & Responsibilities
Worked on generation of medium, low, and high-level alerts for different KPIs.
Alerts on below scenarios:
Scenario 1: Shipments currently delayed (past due); alerts will be graded based on	no. of days past due Scenario 2: Shipments planned in the immediate future at risk of delay
Alert based on latest sales velocity (e.g., last 3-4 weeks) and demand gap
Alert based on significant difference between planned orders (Baseline) & optimizer recommended allocations
Forecasted sales velocity based on the past 3-year data using Time Series models
R programming is used for developmental activities
Azure Devops is used as Scrum platform
Project: 6
Client Name: TDC group Role: Software Engineer Duration: Mar-20 to Feb-21 Roles & Responsibilities
Worked to maximize the no. of 5G connections in different places of Denmark and predict which area might take more connections in future.
Collected the existing data from the customer and divided clusters based on different attributes
Used different clustering algorithms such as K-Means, DBSCAN Clustering etc.
200 clusters were taken, and prediction algorithms were applied on them to predict which area might take more connections in future.
Used prediction algorithms such as Decision tree, Random Forest, Naive Bayes, Ensemble techniques etc.
Python programming is used for developmental activities

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Experience:
Project 1: Pre-screen Calling Agent
Designed and deployed a GenAI-based Patient Pre-screening Agent that engaged patients via
SMS/Email/Twilio integration, and auto-followed up with non-responders.
Leveraged OpenAI LLM, LangChain, AWS Lambda, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Mistral 7B, RAGAS to automate patient eligibility checks and communication.
Result: Increased patient response rates by 42% and reduced manual coordinator workload by 60%.
Project 2: Question Identification System
Built an AI-powered NLP pipeline to detect and eliminate duplicate questions across clinical trial studies, ensuring a clean and standardized knowledge base.
Implemented RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) with FAISS vector database + OpenAI embeddings to enhance duplicate detection accuracy.
Leveraged OpenAI LLM, LangChain, AWS Lambda, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Mistral 7B, RAGAS Project 3: Clinical Trial Adverse Event Classifier
Built an NLP-driven ML pipeline (Logistic Regression, XGBoost, BERT) to classify patient-reported symptoms as Adverse Events vs. Non-Adverse Events .
Standardized reports using MedDRA ontology, handled class imbalance, and engineered temporal/contextual features.
Monitoring (KS Test, PSI) for drift detection and continuous retraining.
Project 4: Automated Patient Condition Extraction from Clinical Conversations
Built an NLP pipeline to classify doctor vs. patient speech in clinical conversations and extract medical conditions (NER + ICD-10 mapping) only from patient statements, auto-filling structured databases.
Used BERT, RoBERTa, DistilBERT,BioClinicalBERT / BlueBERT, ICD-10
Responsibilities:
Utilized Python libraries pandas, numPY
Familiar with JSON based REST Web Services and Amazon Web Services(AWS).
Implemented RAG(Generative AI) to find the similar question in existing question bank
Used prompt engineering(LLM) to find the variance in the similar questions
Used LLM Model to identify medical condition
Used LLm Model to find start date and end date of medical condition
Developed predictive models using Decision Tree, Random Forest and Naïve Bayes and regression techniques
Developed a layer of applications modules over the Python - Pandas library, delivered various data frame visualization tools, Data wrangling and cleaning using Python Pandas.
Performed data cleaning and data processing using Python Data frames.
Extensive experience in Text Analytics, developing different Statistical Machine Learning, Data Mining solutions to various business problems and generating Data. Visualizations using R, Python and Tableau
Developed NLP models for Topic Extraction, Sentiment Analysis.
Work with NLTK library to NLP data processing and finding the patterns.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Experience:
Project 1: Pre-screen Calling Agent
Designed and deployed a GenAI-based Patient Pre-screening Agent that engaged patients via
SMS/Email/Twilio integration, and auto-followed up with non-responders.
Leveraged OpenAI LLM, LangChain, AWS Lambda, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Mistral 7B, RAGAS to automate patient eligibility checks and communication.
Result: Increased patient response rates by 42% and reduced manual coordinator workload by 60%.
Project 2: Question Identification System
Built an AI-powered NLP pipeline to detect and eliminate duplicate questions across clinical trial studies, ensuring a clean and standardized knowledge base.
Implemented RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) with FAISS vector database + OpenAI embeddings to enhance duplicate detection accuracy.
Leveraged OpenAI LLM, LangChain, AWS Lambda, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Mistral 7B, RAGAS Project 3: Clinical Trial Adverse Event Classifier
Built an NLP-driven ML pipeline (Logistic Regression, XGBoost, BERT) to classify patient-reported symptoms as Adverse Events vs. Non-Adverse Events .
Standardized reports using MedDRA ontology, handled class imbalance, and engineered temporal/contextual features.
Monitoring (KS Test, PSI) for drift detection and continuous retraining.
Project 4: Automated Patient Condition Extraction from Clinical Conversations
Built an NLP pipeline to classify doctor vs. patient speech in clinical conversations and extract medical conditions (NER + ICD-10 mapping) only from patient statements, auto-filling structured databases.
Used BERT, RoBERTa, DistilBERT,BioClinicalBERT / BlueBERT, ICD-10
Responsibilities:
Utilized Python libraries pandas, numPY
Familiar with JSON based REST Web Services and Amazon Web Services(AWS).
Implemented RAG(Generative AI) to find the similar question in existing question bank
Used prompt engineering(LLM) to find the variance in the similar questions
Used LLM Model to identify medical condition
Used LLm Model to find start date and end date of medical condition
Developed predictive models using Decision Tree, Random Forest and Naïve Bayes and regression techniques
Developed a layer of applications modules over the Python - Pandas library, delivered various data frame visualization tools, Data wrangling and cleaning using Python Pandas.
Performed data cleaning and data processing using Python Data frames.
Extensive experience in Text Analytics, developing different Statistical Machine Learning, Data Mining solutions to various business problems and generating Data. Visualizations using R, Python and Tableau
Developed NLP models for Topic Extraction, Sentiment Analysis.
Work with NLTK library to NLP data processing and finding the patterns.
Responsibilities:
Responsible for gathering requirements, system analysis, design, development, testing and deployment.
Used Pandas as an API to put the data as time series and tabular format for manipulation and retrieval of data.
Developed features and enhancements Python data structure libraries such as NumPy and Pandas. Extensively used matplotlib for generating graphical representation of data.
Utilized Python libraries like wxPython, NumPy, Twisted, PyQt, Web2py, Pygal, and Plot.ly.
Implemented Garbage collection with Cpython to enhance the performance, by garbage collecting the older

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Software Engineer / Senior Data Analyst
Virtusa Consulting Services – Hyderabad Client: HSBC (Financial Services) Jan 2022 – Present
Project: Finance on the Cloud (FOTC) – Global finance data transformation initiative.
Key Responsibilities:
Supported large-scale financial data transformation programs across enterprise
finance systems.
Worked within Agile, cross-functional teams to design and deliver governed,
high-quality data solutions.
Led business, functional, and non-functional requirement elicitation with
finance stakeholders.
Translated business requirements into conceptual, logical, and physical data
models aligned with governance standards.
Designed reconciliation-ready data structures to support financial reporting and
controls.
Performed metadata analysis, including entity definitions, attribute naming, data
types, lengths, and lineage.
Produced and owned data modeling artifacts, mapping documents, and
analysis deliverables for development teams.
Acted as a bridge between Business, Finance, and IT, ensuring requirement
clarity throughout the SDLC.
Supported end-to-end data journey mapping, from source systems through
transformation to consumption layers.
Used SQL and BigQuery extensively for data analysis, validation, and
reconciliation checks.
Ensured traceability and consistency of data and metadata across
environments.
Senior Data Analyst / BI Analyst
Keolis Hyderabad Mass Rapid Transit System Ltd – Hyderabad Client: L&T Metro Rail Limited Dec 2017 – Jan 2022
Key Responsibilities:
Gathered and analyzed business and technical requirements for enterprise
reporting and analytics.
Designed logical and physical data models to support operational and
management reporting.
Created source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, and business logic
documentation.
Performed data gap analysis and impact assessments across multiple source
systems.
Built and maintained analytics-ready data marts for reporting and reconciliation.
Conducted time-series and trend analysis on transactional datasets.
Developed KPI definitions and ensured alignment between business metrics and
underlying data models.
Worked closely with stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and
usability.
Data Analyst
Concentrix – Visakhapatnam Client: Uber International Apr 2017 – Nov 2017
Key Responsibilities:
Analyzed high-volume transactional datasets including trips, demand, and fare
data.
Created analytical data models to support business reporting and forecasting.
Used SQL for data analysis, validation, and reconciliation.
Developed KPI frameworks and reporting structures aligned with business
objectives.
Translated functional requirements into scalable analytical datasets.

Virtusa Consulting Services – Hyderabad Client: HSBC (Financial Services) Jan 2022 – Present
Project: Finance on the Cloud (FOTC) – Global finance data transformation initiative.

Supported large-scale financial data transformation programs across enterprise
finance systems.
Worked within Agile, cross-functional teams to design and deliver governed,
high-quality data solutions.
Led business, functional, and non-functional requirement elicitation with
finance stakeholders.
Translated business requirements into conceptual, logical, and physical data
models aligned with governance standards.
Designed reconciliation-ready data structures to support financial reporting and
controls.

types, lengths, and lineage.

analysis deliverables for development teams.
Acted as a bridge between Business, Finance, and IT, ensuring requirement
clarity throughout the SDLC.
Supported end-to-end data journey mapping, from source systems through
transformation to consumption layers.
Used SQL and BigQuery extensively for data analysis, validation, and
reconciliation checks.
Ensured traceability and consistency of data and metadata across
environments.

sections.text:
Professional Summary
Seasoned Azure Cloud Architect with 18 years of IT experience and 5+ years of leadership in cloud infrastructure, automation, and DevOps engineering. Demonstrated excellence in architecting and delivering scalable, secure, and high-availability solutions using Azure native services and automation frameworks.
Proficient in designing enterprise architectures such as microservices, service-oriented architecture (SOA), and 3-tier web applications on Azure IaaS and PaaS. Specialized in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipeline design, Kubernetes orchestration, hybrid networking, and cloud security.
A proven strategic thinker and innovation leader, capable of aligning cloud adoption and modernization initiatives with organizational goals. Brings strong communication skills to articulate technical vision to stakeholders and facilitate collaboration across diverse teams. Skilled in client engagement, ensuring business needs are translated into secure, cost-effective, and scalable solutions. Known for setting the technical direction, mentoring junior engineers, and driving continuous improvement by integrating cutting-edge cloud technologies into enterprise frameworks.
Deep expertise in Azure infrastructure planning, subscription modeling, and multi-tenant governance. Experienced in environment provisioning for complex enterprise workloads including Dynamics 365, Azure AD identity integration, and hybrid connectivity. Adept at leading architecture workshops, guiding implementation teams, and ensuring alignment with security and compliance best practices.
Why I’m a Fit: My expertise in DevOps, architectural planning, and cloud modernization is transferable across cloud platforms. While Azure is my primary domain, my engineering approach and delivery methodology align with any enterprise cloud transformation initiative.

Delivered secure and scalable Azure IaaS/PaaS solutions, with resilient networking and high-availability patterns.

Enabled DevSecOps practices, integrating security and compliance scans into pipelines.
Set up robust monitoring, alerting, and observability using Azure Monitor, Prometheus, and Grafana.
Led workshops with enterprise clients for cloud strategy, modernization roadmap, and solution blueprinting.
Provided architectural governance, reviewed HLD/LLDs, and conducted architecture assessments and design reviews.
Designed cloud infrastructure for hybrid and pure Azure deployments, including development, test, and production environments following Microsoft’s Cloud Adoption Framework.
Led subscription modeling across business units, configuring management groups, policies, and budget controls aligned to governance and enterprise access policies.
Architected secure Azure AD integrations, enabling SSO, MFA, and seamless identity lifecycle management across applications including Dynamics 365 F&O.
Delivered disaster recovery strategies using Azure Site Recovery and backup automation to ensure BCP readiness.
Defined and reviewed architecture artifacts like Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTM), Security Design Plans, and Technical Architecture Documents.

sections.label: Awards and achievements
sections.text:
Key Achievements
Reduced deployment time by 50% using Terraform-driven automation frameworks.
Delivered 30% cloud cost savings through optimization and governance policies.
Implemented multi-region AKS architecture with microservices for fault-tolerant systems.
Conducted trade-off analysis and architecture reviews to align with performance and scalability goals.
Led transformation programs for application modernization using SOA and event-driven design principles.
Defined strategic cloud transformation plans for multiple clients, aligning technical roadmaps with business objectives.
Presented technical proposals and architectural frameworks to executive leadership for approval and funding.
Championed client-centered architecture reviews, ensuring delivery was aligned to expectations and KPIs.
Mentored junior architects and DevOps engineers, enabling career progression and skill development.
Pioneered proof-of-concepts on emerging Azure services to support innovation and competitive differentiation.
Enabled organizational cloud maturity uplift by establishing reusable frameworks and governance templates.
Led the Azure infrastructure design for a multi-region enterprise rollout of Dynamics 365 with hybrid identity management and secure B2B access control.
Created technical designs and RTMs that streamlined review cycles by 40%, enhancing traceability and stakeholder confidence.
Devised backup and DR strategies for mission-critical systems, achieving RPO/RTO compliance for all identified workloads.
Delivered multi-layered security architecture using Azure AD, Conditional Access, and Azure Policy to meet ISO27001 compliance.

RESPONSIBILITIES







Copilot Developer, Designed, Developed, and supported Power Platform applications Power Virtual Agents  Provided comprehensive design, development, and maintenance for SharePoint online/On- prem applications including web portals and web-based solutions. Third party integrations with power automate and the custom connectors, AI Builder, Data verse, Model Driven Apps, Gather user activity data for Microsoft SharePoint sites and sub- sites for analysis and evaluation and use SQL server as Database for Power apps. Involved in designing and implementing virtual SharePoint environments for development and testing. Developed POC’s with various requirements with Canvas apps and workflows. Performed SharePoint administrative design and maintain servers SharePoint database. Responsible for design methodology and project documentaries. Developing Copilot Bots, Power Pages.
 Made DAX queries, visual reports, KPI scorecards, and dashboards in Power BI desktop RS version. Developing Power Automate Desktop processes, Excel automation, Web Automation, Ui Automation, Environment variables and many Automations. Scheduled Cloud flows and automated flows are integrated with power automate desktop. Azure Devops Creating Pipeline and releasees for Power platform packages from one environment to another. Error handling and business and system exceptions.

Solution Architecture

Design and implement end-to-end Power Platform solutions with a focus on security, scalability, performance, and maintainability. Integrate Power Apps and Power Automate with enterprise systems such as Azure services, SQL Server, SharePoint, SAP, and third-party connectors.
Technical Leadership

Lead and guide Power Platform Copilot at development teams. Performed code reviews, enforce best practices, and establish coding standards and architectural guidelines.
Governance & Compliance
 Worked on data security, compliance, environment governance, and access control policies.
Implemented Copilot at Center of Excellence (CoE) strategies.
Data Modelling & Integration

Architect complex Dataverse data models, including relationships, security roles, and business rules. Design integrations with external data sources using standard and custom connectors.
Stakeholder Collaboration
Work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into clear technical specifications and solution designs.  Act as a bridge between business teams and technical delivery.
Application Lifecycle Management (ALM)

Establish and manage CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps for Power Platform solutions. Support environment strategy, solution packaging, versioning, deployment, and release management

Projects Worked on Novigo solutions. May 2022 – April - 2024
Project In Percoyo March -2021 - March 2022
Maintaining Servers and cleaning the dB and archives.
SharePoint Online/On -Perm developing web apps and sites and customizing MASTER pages.
Power Virtual Agents Bots.
Creating Lists and connecting the API integration with third party apps.
Exceptional handling of RPA desktop.
Parent flows and major Web extractions.
For Percoyo 6 months on SharePoint and 6 months on biocurators clients.
1. Government Relations Kiosk Automation (Power Apps & Power Automate).
Built a Power Apps Canvas App for SAP ID–based login, video call initiation, and call-not-received scenarios.
Implemented automated logging of events (Login, Video Call Started, Send Note) with timestamp accuracy.
Integrated Power Automate for email notifications and audit logging to SharePoint.
2. MOBARO Results Data Processing Automation
Created SDD for email-driven automation to process MOBARO results.
Designed Power Automate flow to: Filter emails by subject ([EXTERNAL] Results data) Ignore already-processed emails (Loaded: logic).
3. Risk Assessment Framework (2026) – Power Apps Solution. And Copilot Bot Risk Bot.
4. Arabic Contract Automation Solution for Arabic Contract Processing Automation.
5. IT Loan Devices Tracking System
Designed SDD for IT asset / loan device tracking.
Implemented Power Apps solution with Department-based filtering.
6. Email-Driven Data Extraction & Excel Automation
Delivered for extracting data from email links, PDFs, and attachments. Designed multiple automation patterns: SharePoint file links.
7. Machine Availability & RPA Alerting Framework
Authored for machine availability monitoring for Power Automate Desktop bots.
.8. Access Governance & Environment Management (ATD Production)
Documented for Production environment access requests
9. Copilot. Bots Risk Bot, Hr Bot, Employee Bot.
10. Created Power pages for different requirements, I connect, DataMAG,Hover Lift..

Epiroc App- Details of RPA & other tools Jira Statistics
Copilot Bots Digital Bot, Data Surveillance Bot

RPA yearly and Automation in production survey.
Business Voice Actions KPI.
Jira extract for PBI.
Power Automate Desktop Flows Epiroc Client
May 2024 – Jan 2025
Download client URLs Power Automate desktop Using Ui & WEB automation.
Downloading Open orders using web automation.
API Integration data analytics Portal.
Copilot Bots 
SAP data interfaces.
Ui web recording for form data.
Excel automation for invoice details.
OCR for data classification.
Transfer Request App
April 22- Sep 22
Multiple approvals for varying amounts, and each permission is contingent on the amount
when item requests are made. The ability to integrate with Excel to load data into forms.
File extraction and archiving for PDFs.
Sep 22- Jan 23
COI (Conflicts of Interest) App
Developing official documentation and providing information on conflicts of interest, policy
renewals, and approvals, several forms with a responsive app that requires consent for every
request.
May 23
SharePoint Environment Testing
  Verifying the workflows and sites, examining the pages and web applications, and checking
the database. Keeping track of the lists, verifying the APIs, and managing several servers and
setups. Verifying the online application and workflows.
Timesheet App
Oct 23 - Dec 23
completing a monthly time sheet, obtaining approvals, and, if chosen, populating dynamic
calendar selection dates for holidays and weekends
Power Automate
Sep 23 – Feb 24
Power automates RPA bot connection with WhatsApp.
Obtaining patient, practitioner, and multiple option backend data from Epic FHIR, API’s
along with WhatsApp front end and power automate, will automate appointment scheduling.
Choosing places and leaving voice messages.
Power Pages Sep 23 – Feb 24
Power Pages and Power Automate RPA, including bot integration with WhatsApp.
I have worked on solutions that retrieve patient, practitioner, and multi-option backend data from,
integrating it with SAP end and Power Automate to SQL Server
Power Automate Desktop Flows
Sep 23 – Feb 24
Automatic Web Form Filling, automate to find text in the PDF files content into Excel List
through Power Automate Desktop, Reminder to Stretch with Logging
Power BI (Dashboard &Reports)

Sales Dashboard, Expense Reports, Employee Onboarding, Marketing Dashboard, Hospital 

Help Desk, Site Inspection, Budget Tracker, Inventory Management app Sales Order App.
SQL Server
In our Power Apps application, we've integrated SQL Server as our primary data source. This
allows us to store and retrieve data efficiently using the SQL Server database management
system if we want to insert or delete the data that we have also done in SQL.

Projects Worked on Novigo solutions. May 2022 – April - 2024
Project In Percoyo March -2021 - March 2022
Maintaining Servers and cleaning the dB and archives.
SharePoint Online/On -Perm developing web apps and sites and customizing MASTER pages.
Power Virtual Agents Bots.
Creating Lists and connecting the API integration with third party apps.
Exceptional handling of RPA desktop.
Parent flows and major Web extractions.
For Percoyo 6 months on SharePoint and 6 months on biocurators clients.
1. Government Relations Kiosk Automation (Power Apps & Power Automate).
Built a Power Apps Canvas App for SAP ID–based login, video call initiation, and call-not-received scenarios.
Implemented automated logging of events (Login, Video Call Started, Send Note) with timestamp accuracy.
Integrated Power Automate for email notifications and audit logging to SharePoint.
2. MOBARO Results Data Processing Automation
Created SDD for email-driven automation to process MOBARO results.
Designed Power Automate flow to: Filter emails by subject ([EXTERNAL] Results data) Ignore already-processed emails (Loaded: logic).
3. Risk Assessment Framework (2026) – Power Apps Solution. And Copilot Bot Risk Bot.
4. Arabic Contract Automation Solution for Arabic Contract Processing Automation.
5. IT Loan Devices Tracking System
Designed SDD for IT asset / loan device tracking.
Implemented Power Apps solution with Department-based filtering.
6. Email-Driven Data Extraction & Excel Automation
Delivered for extracting data from email links, PDFs, and attachments. Designed multiple automation patterns: SharePoint file links.
7. Machine Availability & RPA Alerting Framework
Authored for machine availability monitoring for Power Automate Desktop bots.
.8. Access Governance & Environment Management (ATD Production)
Documented for Production environment access requests
9. Copilot. Bots Risk Bot, Hr Bot, Employee Bot.
10. Created Power pages for different requirements, I connect, DataMAG,Hover Lift..

Epiroc App- Details of RPA & other tools Jira Statistics
Copilot Bots Digital Bot, Data Surveillance Bot

RPA yearly and Automation in production survey.
Business Voice Actions KPI.
Jira extract for PBI.
Power Automate Desktop Flows Epiroc Client
May 2024 – Jan 2025
Download client URLs Power Automate desktop Using Ui & WEB automation.
Downloading Open orders using web automation.
API Integration data analytics Portal.
Copilot Bots 
SAP data interfaces.
Ui web recording for form data.
Excel automation for invoice details.
OCR for data classification.
Transfer Request App
April 22- Sep 22
Multiple approvals for varying amounts, and each permission is contingent on the amount
when item requests are made. The ability to integrate with Excel to load data into forms.
File extraction and archiving for PDFs.
Sep 22- Jan 23
COI (Conflicts of Interest) App
Developing official documentation and providing information on conflicts of interest, policy
renewals, and approvals, several forms with a responsive app that requires consent for every
request.
May 23
SharePoint Environment Testing
  Verifying the workflows and sites, examining the pages and web applications, and checking
the database. Keeping track of the lists, verifying the APIs, and managing several servers and
setups. Verifying the online application and workflows.
Timesheet App
Oct 23 - Dec 23
completing a monthly time sheet, obtaining approvals, and, if chosen, populating dynamic
calendar selection dates for holidays and weekends
Power Automate
Sep 23 – Feb 24
Power automates RPA bot connection with WhatsApp.
Obtaining patient, practitioner, and multiple option backend data from Epic FHIR, API’s
along with WhatsApp front end and power automate, will automate appointment scheduling.
Choosing places and leaving voice messages.
Power Pages Sep 23 – Feb 24
Power Pages and Power Automate RPA, including bot integration with WhatsApp.
I have worked on solutions that retrieve patient, practitioner, and multi-option backend data from,
integrating it with SAP end and Power Automate to SQL Server
Power Automate Desktop Flows
Sep 23 – Feb 24
Automatic Web Form Filling, automate to find text in the PDF files content into Excel List
through Power Automate Desktop, Reminder to Stretch with Logging
Power BI (Dashboard &Reports)

Sales Dashboard, Expense Reports, Employee Onboarding, Marketing Dashboard, Hospital 

Help Desk, Site Inspection, Budget Tracker, Inventory Management app Sales Order App.
SQL Server
In our Power Apps application, we've integrated SQL Server as our primary data source. This
allows us to store and retrieve data efficiently using the SQL Server database management
system if we want to insert or delete the data that we have also done in SQL.

1.Project: Document Translation Model
Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate and Azure Cognitive Services
Project Description:
Built a document-translation solution using Power Apps as the front end, Power Automate
for orchestration, and Azure Cognitive Services Document Translation to translate documents
across multiple languages while preserving layout and format
Enabled business users to upload documents via Power Apps, triggered translation through
automation workflows, logged metadata in Dataverse, and reduced manual effort
2.Project: Expense Management system
Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate and Azure AI Foundry
Project Description:
Developed an Expense Management System where users upload receipts and invoices via a
Power Apps interface
Leveraged Azure AI Foundry (including GPT-based models) to automatically extract key data
from documents, and orchestrated the workflow with Power Automate.
Built an approver layer where assigned reviewers could view the
extracted data, approve or reject it, after which it was forwarded to the finance team for
final processing.
3.Project: Project Transfer Form Automation
Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate and Azure AI Foundry
Project Description:
Built a sequential multi-stage approval workflow in Power Automate (from approver to
approver) and implemented reminders for any outstanding approvals.
Once all approvers approved, the system generated a PDF and sent it to the uploader; if any
approver rejected, the uploader received an email with comments.
CAPGEMINI INDIA (JUL 2021 to JUN 2023)
Worked as a Power Platform Analyst on various tools on Power Platform like Power BI,
Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Virtual Agents, Dataverse and AI-Builder.

The Power Automate flow will connect Qualtrics surveys - that are sent by GDM BD/AM reps to
vendors when they are interested Gartner’s Landing Page (LP) service - to Monday.com´s
Marketing Services Team workspace.
ZEEL CODE LABS (JUNE 2020 - MAY 2021)
Project Title: Employee Request & Approval Management System

Designed and developed a Canvas App to manage employee service requests such as leave

Automate with email and Teams notifications. Enhanced user experience by creating responsive UI

EXPERIENCE
Worked at STARLITE INFOTECH LIMITED from JUN 2023 to JAN 2026 • Worked at CAPGEMINI INDIA from JUL 2021 to JUN 2023 • Worked at ZEEL CODE LABS as an Intern from JUNE 2020 to MAY 2021
STARLITE INFOTECH LIMITED (June 2023 – Jan 2026)
Worked as a leveraging the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power
BI, Dataverse).
Currently leading cross-functional teams, defining governance and ALM processes, and integrating with Microsoft 365/Azure ecosystems to drive digital transformation and business process automation.
1.Project: Document Translation Model
Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate and Azure Cognitive Services
Project Description:
Built a document-translation solution using Power Apps as the front end, Power Automate for orchestration, and Azure Cognitive Services Document Translation to translate documents across multiple languages while preserving layout and format
Enabled business users to upload documents via Power Apps, triggered translation through
automation workflows, logged metadata in Dataverse, and reduced manual effort
2.Project: Expense Management system
Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate and Azure AI Foundry
Project Description:
Developed an Expense Management System where users upload receipts and invoices via a
Power Apps interface
• Leveraged Azure AI Foundry (including GPT-based models) to automatically extract key data
from documents, and orchestrated the workflow with Power Automate.
Built an approver layer where assigned reviewers could view the
extracted data, approve or reject it, after which it was forwarded to the finance team for
final processing.
3.Project: Project Transfer Form Automation
Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate and Azure AI Foundry
Project Description:
Built a sequential multi-stage approval workflow in Power Automate (from approver to
approver) and implemented reminders for any outstanding approvals.
Once all approvers approved, the system generated a PDF and sent it to the uploader; if any
approver rejected, the uploader received an email with comments.
CAPGEMINI INDIA (JUL 2021 to JUN 2023)
Worked as a Power Platform Analyst on various tools on Power Platform like Power BI,
Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Virtual Agents, Dataverse and AI-Builder.
Created 120 Power Automate Cloud Flows,10 PowerApps Canvas Application, 2 Model
Driven Apps, 8 Power BI Dashboards and 2 Power Virtual Agent Chatbot.
1.Project: RES Plus Rock Heroes - Monthly Voting
Technologies: PowerApps and Power Automate
Project Description:
This Power App allows monthly recognition of associates by their managers, with each
manager limited to one vote per associate per month.
A Power Automate Flow captures responses from a Nomination Microsoft Form and inserts
them into a SharePoint list for managers to vote for their associates.
2.Project: RH Optimization
Technologies: Power BI, PowerApps, Power Automate and Dataverse
Project Description:
This Power App allows monthly recognition of associates by their managers, with each
manager limited to one vote per associate per month.
A Power Automate Flow captures responses from a Nomination Microsoft Form and inserts
them into a SharePoint list for managers to vote for their associates.
3.Project: Send Qualtrics Response to Monday for Software and Services Survey
Technologies: Power Automate
Project Description:
The Power Automate flow will connect Qualtrics surveys - that are sent by GDM BD/AM reps to vendors when they are interested Gartner’s Landing Page (LP) service - to Monday.com´s Marketing Services Team workspace.
ZEEL CODE LABS (JUNE 2020 - MAY 2021)
Project Title: Employee Request & Approval Management System Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint
Description: Designed and developed a Canvas App to manage employee service requests such as leave applications, asset requests, and approvals. Integrated the application with SharePoint and Dataverse for centralized data storage. Implemented automated approval workflows using Power Automate with email and Teams notifications. Enhanced user experience by creating responsive UI screens and validation logic using Power Fx.

targets.text: ABHISHEK HANASHI
Platform Engineer
Email: abhishek.hanashi02@gmail.com
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Having 5+ years of experience in Power Apps Developer skilled in building Canvas and
Model-Driven applications using Power Platform, Dataverse, and Power Automate.
Power Apps: Canvas Apps & Model-Driven Apps, responsive UI design, Power Fx formulas,
validations, reusable components, role-based access, performance optimization
Dataverse: Table/entity creation, relationships, business rules, calculated columns, views, forms,
Power Automate: Automated, instant & scheduled flows, approval workflows, Dataverse
triggers, expressions, conditions, error handling, integration with Power Apps
Integration: REST APIs, HTTP actions, JSON handling, standard connectors (SharePoint,
Security & ALM: Environment management, security roles, DLP policies, solutions (managed &
Tools & Methodologies: SharePoint Online, SQL (basic), Excel (advanced), Git (basic), Azure
Experienced in workflow automation, integrations, and Agile delivery.
charts, dashboards, security roles, data import/export
Outlook, Teams, Excel, SQL), custom connectors (basic)
unmanaged), deployment best practices
DevOps (basic), Agile / Scrum
Experience with JavaScript and Web API.
Worked on Creating Teams and Access teams.
Work Experience with Ribbon Workbench.
EXPERIENCE
Worked at STARLITE INFOTECH LIMITED from JUN 2023 to JAN 2026
Worked at CAPGEMINI INDIA from JUL 2021 to JUN 2023
Worked at ZEEL CODE LABS as an Intern from JUNE 2020 to MAY 2021
EDUCATION

Bachelors of Engineering (BE) In Electronics and Communication Engineering, from Jain
College of Engineering Belagavi, Karnataka

PROJECTS HANDLED
STARLITE INFOTECH LIMITED (June 2023 – Jan 2026)
Worked as a leveraging the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power
BI, Dataverse).
Currently leading cross-functional teams, defining governance and ALM processes, and
integrating with Microsoft 365/Azure ecosystems to drive digital transformation and
business process automation.
1.Project: Document Translation Model
Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate and Azure Cognitive Services
Project Description:
Built a document-translation solution using Power Apps as the front end, Power Automate
for orchestration, and Azure Cognitive Services Document Translation to translate documents
across multiple languages while preserving layout and format
Enabled business users to upload documents via Power Apps, triggered translation through
automation workflows, logged metadata in Dataverse, and reduced manual effort
2.Project: Expense Management system
Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate and Azure AI Foundry
Project Description:
Developed an Expense Management System where users upload receipts and invoices via a
Power Apps interface
Leveraged Azure AI Foundry (including GPT-based models) to automatically extract key data
from documents, and orchestrated the workflow with Power Automate.
Built an approver layer where assigned reviewers could view the
extracted data, approve or reject it, after which it was forwarded to the finance team for
final processing.
3.Project: Project Transfer Form Automation
Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate and Azure AI Foundry
Project Description:
Built a sequential multi-stage approval workflow in Power Automate (from approver to
approver) and implemented reminders for any outstanding approvals.
Once all approvers approved, the system generated a PDF and sent it to the uploader; if any
approver rejected, the uploader received an email with comments.
CAPGEMINI INDIA (JUL 2021 to JUN 2023)
Worked as a Power Platform Analyst on various tools on Power Platform like Power BI,
Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Virtual Agents, Dataverse and AI-Builder.
Created 120 Power Automate Cloud Flows,10 PowerApps Canvas Application, 2 Model
Driven Apps, 8 Power BI Dashboards and 2 Power Virtual Agent Chatbot.
1.Project: RES Plus Rock Heroes - Monthly Voting
Technologies: PowerApps and Power Automate
Project Description:
This Power App allows monthly recognition of associates by their managers, with each
manager limited to one vote per associate per month.
A Power Automate Flow captures responses from a Nomination Microsoft Form and inserts
them into a SharePoint list for managers to vote for their associates.
2.Project: RH Optimization
Technologies: Power BI, PowerApps, Power Automate and Dataverse
Project Description:
This Power App allows monthly recognition of associates by their managers, with each
manager limited to one vote per associate per month.
A Power Automate Flow captures responses from a Nomination Microsoft Form and inserts
them into a SharePoint list for managers to vote for their associates.
3.Project: Send Qualtrics Response to Monday for Software and Services Survey
Technologies: Power Automate
Project Description:
The Power Automate flow will connect Qualtrics surveys - that are sent by GDM BD/AM reps to
vendors when they are interested Gartner’s Landing Page (LP) service - to Monday.com´s
Marketing Services Team workspace.
ZEEL CODE LABS (JUNE 2020 - MAY 2021)
Project Title: Employee Request & Approval Management System
Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint
Description:
Designed and developed a Canvas App to manage employee service requests such as leave
applications, asset requests, and approvals. Integrated the application with SharePoint and
Dataverse for centralized data storage. Implemented automated approval workflows using Power
Automate with email and Teams notifications. Enhanced user experience by creating responsive UI
screens and validation logic using Power Fx.
Personal Details
